mentions.name: allscreenshots.com
mentions.description: A screenshot API for developers that auto-dismisses cookie consent dialogs using Playwright heuristics, serves AVIF-first images from Cloudflare R2, and supports geo-distributed rendering so pages can be captured as they would appear from different regions. Built with Spring Boot, React, and PostgreSQL.
mentions.problem: Existing screenshot services choke on cookie banners, render half-loaded pages, and serve bloated images.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://allscreenshots.com - a screenshot API for developers.

I got frustrated with existing screenshot services choking on cookie banners, rendering half-loaded pages, and serving bloated images. So my co-founder and I built one that auto-dismisses cookie consent dialogs using Playwright heuristics, serves AVIF-first from Cloudflare R2, and supports geo-distributed rendering so you can capture pages as they'd appear from different regions.
